response.overview: This Emmy-winning special event serves as a fierce, meta-fictional satire targeting corporate streaming consolidation and modern political absurdity. Launching a mere day after creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone signed a historic contract extension with Paramount, the narrative follows Jesus Christ literally returning to South Park Elementary to guide the town through an existential crisis. When a furious President Donald Trump slaps the town with an astronomical $5 billion lawsuit, Jesus is forced to step in to broker a peace settlement and save the show from corporate annihilation, all while Trump enters a chaotic, secret romance with Satan in the White House.
response.title: South Park: Jesus is Back!
